reason: I already had my information stolen in a breach, so I am not making an account on lawsuitai.org to look up a settlement I heard about on TikTok. And you still make me file the official form myself, which is the part I never get around to anyway.
objection: Is this a scam or a data grab? A free site that wants an account, admits the listings are unverified, and might start charging later is exactly how you get burned a second time.
would_change_my_mind: Let me search my named breach and open the official administrator form with no account and no email, and have something that actually nags me before the deadline instead of another tab I will ignore.
